name: Crossword Puzzle Benchmark
description: A benchmark evaluating LLM ability to solve crossword clues, requiring encyclopedic knowledge, wordplay understanding, and constraint satisfaction. Various versions exist testing both individual clue solving and complete grid-filling.
reputation: Niche but interesting benchmark for testing knowledge retrieval and constraint reasoning; used in Tree of Thought paper
notes: Used as one of three tasks in the Tree of Thoughts (ToT) paper to demonstrate structured reasoning. NYT Mini Crossword variants are commonly used. Tests world knowledge and constraint satisfaction.
